top_risk: Small TAM limited to golf enthusiasts, difficult supply-side acquisition, and low barriers to entry for competitors
analysis_note: Marketplace model has chicken-and-egg challenges and typically 10-20% take rates once scaled, but golf is a small vertical. Market size is fundamentally limited to ~24M US golfers with questionable expansion beyond that demographic, and no clear moat against course management software incumbents or direct booking. Would need to see exceptional supply-side traction (hundreds of courses committed) or evidence of expansion into broader leisure booking to justify investment.
